import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Check if any feature shows significant association with outcome
    p_values = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            # For clinical features, use t-test
            group0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
            group1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(group0, group1, equal_var=False)
        else:
            # For other features, compute correlation with outcome
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, i], feats.y)[0, 1]
            p_val = 2 * (1 - stats.norm.cdf(abs(corr) * np.sqrt(len(feats.y) - 2) / np.sqrt(1 - corr**2)))
        p_values.append(p_val)
    
    # If no feature is significantly associated, return empty design
    if all(p > 0.05 for p in p_values):
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Find top features by significance
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(p_values)
    top_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:10]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation matrix
    to_remove = set()
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in top_features]])
    for i in range(len(top_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_features)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i, j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(top_features[j])
    
    selected_features = [fid for fid in top_features if fid not in to_remove]
    
    # Fit logistic regression with all selected features
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in selected_features]]
    model = LogisticRegression(fit_intercept=True, penalty=None)
    model.fit(X, feats.y)
    
    # Get coefficients and select top ones
    coefs = np.abs(model.coef_[0])
    top_coef_indices = np.argsort(coefs)[-MAX_DRIVERS:][::-1]
    drivers = tuple([selected_features[i] for i in top_coef_indices])
    
    # Return design with all selected features
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=tuple(selected_features),
        products=(),
        loadings={fid: float(model.coef_[0][i]) 
                 for i, fid in enumerate(selected_features)}
    )
